title: Shozamaks Optimized
description: Lightweight Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.x. Maximum FPS, rendering optimization, and useful QoL mods (Sodium, Lithium, AppleSkin).
body:
[Shozamaks optimized] — FPS, Atmosphere & Convenience

[Shozamaks optimized] is a client-side modpack based on Fabric, designed to make Minecraft faster, more beautiful, and more convenient without altering vanilla gameplay. It is perfect for both singleplayer and server play (Anarchy, Survival).

✨ Key Features:

🔥 Maximum Optimization: Thanks to Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and other mods, you will get high FPS even on low-end PCs.

🎨 Incredible Visuals: Shader support via Iris, improved particles from Visuality, and realistic fog with SimpleFog.

🔊 Atmospheric Sound: Full immersion with AmbientSounds (nature sounds) and Sound Physics Remastered (echoes, sound absorption).

🛠️ Convenient Interface (HUD):

JourneyMap — World map and minimap.

AppleSkin — Food saturation display.

Armor HUD — Armor status on screen.

ShulkerBoxTooltip — View shulker box contents without placing them.

📦 List of Key Mods:

Core/Optimization: Sodium, Lithium, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast.

Visual Effects: Iris Shaders, Visuality, 3D Skin Layers, NotEnoughAnimations.

Utility: Mouse Tweaks, Resourcify, Wi Zoom, BetterF3.

📥 Installation:

Download and install the Modrinth App or Prism Launcher.

Create a new profile and import this modpack.

Enjoy stable gameplay!
